first-idea.name: Umbono wokuqala
first-idea.line: Ingxoxo yokuqala nya, ngaphambi kokuba kube khona ikhodi.
first-board.name: Ibhodi lokuqala
first-board.line: Ibhodi elilandelela ukwakhiwa kwalo: amakhadi, amakholomu, donsa uphonse, amaphrojekthi.
team-roles.name: Iqembu nezindima
team-roles.line: Amaphrofayela ama-ejenti, amathempulethi eqembu, izikhala nokuthi ngubani owenzani.
install.name: Ukufaka nokukhishwa
install.line: I-zip umngani angayifaka, ukuzibuyekeza, amashaneli nokubuyela emuva.
usage-saver.name: Ukonga ukusetshenziswa
usage-saver.line: Linganisa izindleko zokusebenza, gcina ikhodi incane, onge umkhawulo wakho.
friends.name: Abangani nokwabelana
friends.line: Imilayezo eyimfihlo, isidlulisi esixubekile, izimemo, izindima namaphrojekthi abelwanayo.
languages.name: Izilimi
languages.line: Yonke imibhalo yesikrini ifayelini lolimi, kuqala ngesiDashi nesiFlemish.
ai-tester.name: Umhloli we-AI
ai-tester.line: Umhloli uhlola ukudluliselwa ngakunye kuqala bese ekhombisa ayekubonile.
website.name: Iwebhusayithi
streaming.name: Ingxoxo nokusakaza
streaming.line: I-Discord, i-Twitch, i-OBS, imodi yomsakazi, ama-GIF nama-emoji.
no-ai.name: Uhlelo olungenayo i-AI
no-ai.line: Ibhodi labantu abakhipha ikhodi ngaphandle kwe-AI, namabhodi omphakathi.
night-watch.name: Ukuqapha ebusuku
night-watch.line: Umqaphi ne-Scrum Master baqhubekisa amaqembu emsebenzini ngenkathi ulele.
p-more.name: Konke okunye
p-more.line: Imibono emincane ekhona isalindele ithuba layo.
p-android.name: Ifoni ne-Android
p-android.line: Finyelela ibhodi lakho ofonini, bese kuba uhlelo lwangempela lwe-Android.
p-release.name: I-alpha nangale kwayo
p-release.line: I-alpha evaliwe, isayithi eliphilayo, bese i-beta.
p-languages.name: Izilimi eziningi
p-languages.line: Izilimi ezingaphezu kwekhulu, nemodi yokucwiliswa yabafundi.
p-engines.name: Izinjini ze-AI eziningi
p-engines.line: Khetha i-Claude, i-Codex noma i-Gemini ku-ejenti ngayinye.
p-pro.name: Umkhuba wochwepheshe
p-pro.line: Amalebula obungozi, amasango okuhlanganisa, amakhadi ezehlakalo nezivikelo.
p-self.name: Ukukunakekela
p-servers.name: Amaseva nobukhulu
p-servers.line: Izilungiselelo zamaseva jikelele, izindima nokuhlela ukukhula.
p-livestream.name: Okungeziwe kokusakaza
p-livestream.line: Ingxoxo ye-Twitch, ama-emoji ngokwezifiso nombono womphakathi ophilayo.
